title: MCP++ ExecutionEnvelope@1
description: Canonical portable execution envelope for MCP++ 1.0. Top-level carrier covering identity, authority, intent, inputs/outputs, constraints, state, policy, and provenance. Profiles B, C, D, F, and G remain modular contents or CID references; this object is the shared wire carrier (plan KD-7). Interface: ExecutionEnvelope@1. Normative prose: ipfs_accelerate_py/mcplusplus/docs/spec/execution-envelope.md.
$comment: Interface label: ExecutionEnvelope@1. Schema marker: mcp++/execution/envelope@1. Historical Profile B envelopes adapt without silent CID breakage (MCPP-031). Wall-clock timestamps are informational; causal order comes from parents and logical clocks.

interface_cid.description: Identity: CID of the MCP-IDL Interface Descriptor (Profile A) being invoked.

method.description: Optional method / tool name within the interface. When null, the method is recovered solely from intent_cid contents.

input_cid.description: Inputs: CID of the canonicalized request input payload.

expected_output_schema_cid.description: Outputs: optional CID of the expected output schema / contract for this invocation.

intent_cid.description: Intent: CID of the immutable plan-to-act object (what will be attempted).

constraints.description: Constraints: optional inline operational bounds. Prefer constraints_cid when the constraint object is large or shared.

constraints_cid.description: Constraints: optional CID of a content-addressed constraints object (may equal or narrow policy_cid).

state_refs.description: State: declared StateRef handles this envelope may read or write. Empty when the invocation is pure / immutable-only.

policy_cid.description: Policy: CID of the temporal deontic policy (Profile D) to evaluate. Null when policy is not required for this invocation.

decision_cid.description: Policy: optional precomputed decision CID when evaluation already occurred and is being carried for replay.

authority.description: Authority: delegation / proof references that authorize this envelope. Transport identity is never sufficient (KD-14).

audience.description: Identity: intended executor / audience principal when known before dispatch.

parents.description: Provenance: causal parent CIDs (prior envelopes, events, or receipts). Empty for root invocations.

created_at_ms.description: Provenance: wall-clock creation time (epoch ms). Informational only; not causal authority.

correlation_id.description: Provenance / observability: correlation hook for multi-step tasks (non-normative for causality).

nonce.description: Optional anti-replay nonce. Distinct from correlation_id when both are present.

deadline_ms.description: Optional absolute deadline (epoch ms) for starting or completing execution.

declared_side_effects.description: Declared intended side effects (capability strings or effect CIDs as strings) for policy evaluation.

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization algorithm for envelope CID minting. Required on new mints.

metadata_cid.description: Optional CID of non-authoritative metadata (UI labels, free-form tags). MUST NOT carry authority or policy.

profile_b_envelope_cid.description: Optional adapter field: historical Profile B envelope CID when adapting without rewriting it (MCPP-031).

cid.description: IPFS CID. CIDv1 base32 (b…) preferred for new mints; CIDv0 (Qm…) remains readable when historical.

peer_id.description: Optional transport PeerID. NEVER grants execution authority (KD-14).

proof_cids.description: UCAN / delegation proof CIDs authorizing this envelope. Empty only for same-trust-domain local execution that does not claim portable authority.

proof_cid.description: Optional single primary proof-bundle CID (Profile B compatibility).

delegation_cids.description: Optional explicit delegation record CIDs (full-name wire form) when distinct from proof bundles.

resource.description: Optional primary resource string the authority is scoped to.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum wall-clock execution time in milliseconds.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum output payload size in bytes.

max_retries.description: Client/executor retry budget for this envelope.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for durable executors (crash recovery without duplicate effects).

fencing_token.description: Optional fencing token for exclusive work (Profile G).

lease_ms.description: Optional lease duration for exclusive claims.

state_ref_cid.description: CID of a StateRef@1 (or historical state handle) this envelope may touch.

mode.description: Declared consistency mode when known in advance (KD-8). MUST match the StateRef when both are present.

access.description: Declared access intent for policy evaluation.
